ms.promise:
Smoke tests are incorporated in the Merge Request to add Cardano to Maya Protocol. 

﻿﻿What are smoke tests?
Smoke tests of chains all go in one single python file (Kujira example: https://gitlab.com/mayachain/mayanode/-/blob/develop/test/smoke/chains/kuji.py?ref_type=heads ).
The Smoke Tests (where there is smoke, there is fire) go through many different transactions and test for exact balances at each step: 
-Wallet and Vault Balances on the Cardano Pool 
-Balances in state on Maya 
-Pool and Bond rewards Fees collected 
This ensures that Maya Protocol is processing all transactions, down to the smallest unit, exactly as planned. The complexity around gas handling is even tracked.
ms.criteria: Have the Cardano smoke tests in the MR to add Cardano to MAYANode.
ms.report:
The smoke tests can be found in the following merge request: https://gitlab.com/mayachain/mayanode/-/merge_requests/373/diffs
all the edits for Cardano for smoke tests are in the folder `test/smoke/`, 
the following files were modified to add support for Cardano smoke tests (these are also highlighted in the merge request)
test/smoke/chains/aliases.py
test/smoke/chains/cardano.py
test/smoke/scripts/smoke.py
test/smoke/requirements.txt
Video going over the smoke tests: https://youtu.be/ioK_VyGmBEE
